engine: FAO-56 engine (ported from team MATLAB prototype V8)

geometry.method: WGS84 local tangent plane (Rm/Rn at mean latitude) + shoelace, as in MATLAB V8

climate_history.source: NASA POWER daily (community=AG), MERRA-2/CERES based, ~0.5 x 0.625 deg grid - not field-level

forecast_anomaly.source: NOAA National Weather Service api.weather.gov (7-day forecast periods)
forecast_anomaly.baseline: NASA POWER T2M 2015-2024, same calendar days
forecast_anomaly.note: Mean of day-high/night-low periods vs daily-mean baseline; short-range context only, not used in crop cards.

climate_projection.source: Open-Meteo Climate API, model MRI_AGCM3_2_S (CMIP6 HighResMIP), as queried by V8
climate_projection.et0_method: FAO-56 Penman-Monteith computed from model daily fields (API et0 field is null for climate models)
climate_projection.note: One climate model, one trajectory: a plausible range (scenario), not a forecast. V8's 0.6/0.4 model-trend blending is not ported (unsourced weights).

kc.source: FAO-56 Table 12 (Allen et al. 1998, FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56)
